2239-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.

Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.

Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sage of Hours.
When Sage of Hours dies, its undying ability and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Humans and Wizards.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1494-2527-3784-4275-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.

When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
